sources.title: Buccaneers bring back Sean Tucker
sources.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers today announced that the team has re-signed running back Sean Tucker. Tucker (5-10, 205) has appeared in 45 career games for the Buccaneers, totaling 151 rushes for 651 rushing yards (4.3 yards per carry) and nine rushing touchdowns to go with 19 receptions for 152 receiving yards and two touchdowns.
